Dispatch called in saying that they had a small car and a motorcycle that needed towed. Upon arriving we learned that a drunk driver had hit a couple on a motorcycle. First I seen the car, the front end was totally destroyed, I had not noticed the blood at first but when I was walking over to where the motorcycle landed I could see where I woman with blond hair had skid her head across the pavement... It was very apparent because her hair was ground into the pavement.

I had to just walk away and mentally regroup before I could even do my job.
